about: Synthetic demo cases written for this project (fictional travel-insurance claims). Expected outcomes were derived by hand from the policy rules. The 30-case evaluation set used for the reported AWS results is not included in this repository.

claim_form.description: I had stomach pain while travelling and went to a hospital.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case (created 2026-10-20, Appendix C format) targeting T01 INCOMPLETE. Missing submission_date, claimed_amount and any supporting document (Policy 1.1).

claim_form.description: I was treated in an emergency room for a severe flu on 2026-04-05, just before my insured trip began.

documents.text: City Hospital - Itemized Statement. Patient: Priya Shah. Treatment date 2026-04-05. Emergency consultation 400.00. IV fluids and medication 800.00. Total 1,200.00 CAD equivalent.
Physician report, 2026-04-06. Diagnosis: severe influenza, onset 2026-04-05. Patient treated and discharged the same day.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case targeting T02 NOT_COVERED: incident date 2026-04-05 is before coverage_start 2026-04-10 (Policy 2.1). Complete and otherwise valid.

claim_form.description: I sprained my ankle on 2026-04-15 and was treated in an emergency room as an outpatient.

documents.text: General Hospital - Itemized Statement. Patient: Marco Ruiz. Treatment date 2026-04-15. Emergency consultation 300.00. X-ray 200.00. Ankle treatment and brace 400.00. Total 900.00 CAD equivalent.
Physician report, 2026-04-16. Diagnosis: sprained ankle, 2026-04-15. Patient was treated as an outpatient and discharged the same day. The patient was not admitted to hospital at any time.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case targeting T03 LATE_FILING: filed 96 days after incident (verified: 2026-04-15 to 2026-07-20 = 96 days), no hospitalization documented, so the 90-day deadline in 3.1 applies.

claim_form.description: I broke my arm on 2026-04-15. I filed late because I was recovering from surgery.

documents.text: General Hospital - Itemized Statement. Patient: Lena Fischer. Emergency consultation 400.00. Surgical repair of fractured arm 800.00. Imaging 300.00. Total 1,500.00 CAD equivalent.

Physician report, 2026-08-01. Diagnosis: fractured arm, injury date 2026-04-15. The patient was admitted to hospital from 2026-04-18 to 2026-04-22 for surgical repair and observation, then discharged.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case for the 3.2 hospitalization extension: filed 119 days after incident (verified: 2026-04-15 to 2026-08-12 = 119 days) but the claimant was hospitalized 2026-04-18 to 2026-04-22, within 90 days of the incident, so the deadline is 180 days and the claim is timely. Expected APPROVED 1500.00.

claim_form.description: I cancelled my trip on 2026-04-12 and am claiming the non-refundable costs.

documents.text: Supplier statement, 2026-04-12. Customer: Sarah Kim. Non-refundable prepaid flight and hotel costs: total 1,800.00 CAD. Booking is non-refundable.
Email from Sarah Kim to the supplier, 2026-04-12: I have changed my mind about this trip and decided not to travel. Please cancel my booking.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case targeting T04 EXCLUDED: trip cancelled because of a change of mind, which 4.2 lists as not covered. Documents are complete, so the outcome is a full exclusion, not missing documents (7.1 order).

claim_form.description: I had emergency surgery for appendicitis on 2026-04-16.

documents.text: General Hospital - Itemized Statement. Patient: David Lee. Admission 2026-04-16. Emergency consultation 300.00. Appendectomy 800.00. Total 1,100.00 CAD equivalent.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case targeting T05 PENDING_DOCUMENTS / MISSING_DOCUMENTS: medical claim with an itemized bill but no physician report, which 6.3 requires. Nothing is excluded, so D05 routes to T05 after the FULL-exclusion check.

claim_form.description: The airline lost my suitcase on 2026-04-15.

documents.text: Property Irregularity Report, carrier, 2026-04-15. Passenger: Emma Wilson. One suitcase lost and not recovered.
Claimant item list, 2026-05-05. Lost items: one suitcase, value 80.00 CAD. No other items.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case targeting T06 BELOW_DEDUCTIBLE: baggage claim with one eligible item of 80.00 (no receipt needed, at or below 200 per 5.1). Eligible 80.00 minus the 100.00 deductible in 5.3 / 8.1 floors to 0.

claim_form.description: I was treated for severe food poisoning on 2026-04-15.

documents.text: General Hospital - Itemized Statement. Patient: James Park. Treatment date 2026-04-15. Emergency consultation 300.00. Treatment and medication 500.00. Total 800.00 CAD equivalent.
Physician report, 2026-04-16. Diagnosis: severe food poisoning, onset 2026-04-15. Patient treated and discharged the same day.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case targeting T07 REFERRED_SIU: otherwise payable medical claim (800.00), but prior_claims_last_12_months is 3, which triggers fraud indicator 9.1(c) (more than two prior claims). Expected payable_amount records the amount computed at N07 before referral - state this convention in the design document.

documents.text: General Hospital - Itemized Statement. Patient: Olivia Brown. Admission 2026-04-15. Emergency consultation 500.00. Surgery 4,800.00. Imaging 700.00. Medication 500.00. Total 6,500.00 CAD equivalent.
Physician report, 2026-04-16. Diagnosis: acute appendicitis, onset 2026-04-15. Emergency surgery performed the same day. No pre-existing conditions recorded.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case targeting T08 ADJUSTER_REJECTED: payable 6,500.00 is above the 5,000 auto-approval threshold (10.2), no fraud indicators (policy bought 44 days before the incident, so 9.1(a) does not apply even though the amount exceeds 3,000), and the simulated adjuster rejects.

documents.text: General Hospital - Itemized Statement. Patient: Noah Tremblay. Admission 2026-04-15. Emergency consultation 600.00. Surgery 5,000.00. Imaging 800.00. Medication 400.00. Total 6,800.00 CAD equivalent.
Physician report, 2026-04-16. Diagnosis: acute appendicitis, onset 2026-04-15. Emergency surgery performed the same day. No pre-existing conditions recorded.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case for H01 approve: payable 6,800.00, above 5,000, simulated adjuster approves, so the path continues H01 -> N09 -> T09 APPROVED. Note for Part 4: if the Section 10 threshold were raised to 7,500, this exact case would bypass H01 entirely - a concrete before/after example for the change-management walkthrough.

claim_form.description: Claim submitted on 2026-04-16 during my trip. See attached documents.

documents.text: General Hospital - Itemized Statement. Patient: Nora Ali. Treatment date 2026-04-16. Emergency consultation 350.00. Kidney stone treatment 1,000.00. Total 1,350.00 CAD equivalent.
Physician report, 2026-04-17. Diagnosis: kidney stone, sudden onset 2026-04-16. Emergency treatment provided. No pre-existing conditions recorded.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case for Policy 1.2 claim-type precedence: the form says BAGGAGE_LOSS but the documents describe a medical expense, so the resolved claim type is MEDICAL_EXPENSE and D04 must route to N06, not N05. A monolithic baseline is likely to follow the form and take the wrong branch - a good chain-error comparison case.

claim_form.description: I developed pneumonia on 2026-04-11 and my doctor said I cannot travel, so I cancelled my trip.

documents.text: Supplier statement, 2026-04-11. Customer: Ethan Wright. Non-refundable prepaid costs: flight 1,800.00, hotel 3,200.00. Total non-refundable prepaid costs 5,000.00 CAD.
Medical note, 2026-04-11. Patient: Ethan Wright. Diagnosis: pneumonia, onset 2026-04-11. The patient is medically unfit to travel and must not travel.

cases.note: Synthetic stand-in case for the Section 10 boundary: payable is exactly 5,000.00. Policy 10.1 approves amounts up to and including 5,000 automatically, and D08 routes to H01 only when payable_amount > 5000, so this case must NOT pass through H01. Trip cancellation for sickness (4.1), both 4.3 documents present, no deductible (4.4), at the 5,000 trip cancellation limit.
